title: quote -run regexes that contain the pipe character when Check lines go into role briefs, so read-only roles can run them as written

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
The gate reported this as tool feedback (friction) on ork in ork run ork-20261122-025921-2e6a, project ork, item S434:

quote -run regexes that contain the pipe character when Check lines go into role briefs, so read-only roles can run them as written
